;Arts and culture
*Federal agents have joined the investigation of a fire that destroys a 125 year-old landmark [[Catholic Church]] of the Visitation in [[Westphalia, Texas]]. After storms destroyed two earlier church structures in the 1880s, the Church of Visitation was completed in February of 1895 and dedicated on May 23, 1895. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/atf-investigates-painful-fire-that-destroyed-125-year-old-texas-catholic-church-80451 (Catholic News Agency)]
